description: Stable MathJax TeX testcase slices for staged TeX math renderer development. Counts are documented in design/mathjax-tex-corpus-slices.md.

core-baseline.description: Base LaTeX math constructs from MathJax Base, Ams, and Mathtools tests. This is the broad first-pass development corpus.

latex-oracle-candidates.description: All extracted snippets that the classifier currently considers clean LuaLaTeX oracle candidates.

extra-oracle-candidates.description: LuaLaTeX-oracle candidates outside Base/Ams/Mathtools, useful once the core-baseline slice is stable.

display-environments.description: Display math environments, tagging, cases, proofs, and package-backed display constructs.

font-symbol-text.description: Font alphabets, text-in-math, Unicode, and symbol-table coverage.

macro-diagnostics.description: Macro expansion, package configuration, grouping, and noerrors/noundefined diagnostic policy.

extension-inventory.description: Large package-extension inventory. These are useful for feature discovery, not as an immediate exact-LaTeX target.

html-color-action.description: HTML, color, action, bbox, and enclosure commands. Mostly explicit non-LaTeX or low-priority extension behavior.
